1.3 Acceptance. Client shall have ten (10) business days from delivery of any Deliverable to inspect and test the Deliverable. If Client fails to notify Vendor of rejection within such period, the Deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

ARTICLE 2: FEES AND PAYMENT TERMS
2.1 Fees. Client shall pay Vendor the fees set forth in each applicable SOW.
2.2 Invoicing. Vendor shall submit invoices on a monthly basis. All invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.
2.3 Late Payments. Late payments shall accrue interest at a rate of 1.5% per month or the highest rate permitted by California law, whichever is less.
2.4 Taxes. All fees are exclusive of applicable federal, state, or local sales, use, or value-added taxes, which shall be the sole responsibility of Client.

ARTICLE 3: CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA SECURITY
3.1 Confidential Information. Each party agrees to hold in confidence all proprietary and non-public technical, business, and financial information disclosed by the other party.
3.2 Standard of Care. Each party shall use at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, but in no event less than reasonable care.
3.3 Exclusions. Confidential Information shall not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was already known to the receiving party; or (c) is independently developed without reference to the disclosing party's information.
3.4 Data Security. Vendor shall implement and maintain reasonable administrative, physical, and technical safeguards designed to protect the security and confidentiality of Client Data.

ARTICLE 4: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS
4.1 Client Materials. Client retains all right, title, and interest in and to all materials, data, and intellectual property provided by Client to Vendor.
4.2 Work Product. Subject to full payment of all fees, Vendor hereby assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in and to custom code and deliverables created exclusively for Client under an SOW.
4.3 Pre-Existing IP. Vendor retains ownership of all pre-existing software, frameworks, libraries, and tools ("Vendor Tools"). Vendor grants Client a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free license to use Vendor Tools incorporated into Deliverables.

ARTICLE 5: WARRANTIES AND DISCLAIMERS
5.1 Performance Warranty. Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional, workmanlike manner in accordance with prevailing industry standards.
5.2 Disclaimer. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED HEREIN, NEITHER PARTY MAKES ANY WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

ARTICLE 6: INDEMNIFICATION
6.1 Vendor Indemnification. Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Client from and against any third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe any United States copyright, patent, or trade secret.
6.2 Client Indemnification. Client shall defend and indemnify Vendor from any third-party claims arising from Client Materials or unauthorized modifications to Deliverables.
6.3 Procedure. The indemnified party must give prompt written notice of any claim and allow the indemnifying party sole control of defense and settlement.

ARTICLE 7: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
7.1 Cap on Liability. EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF SECTION 3 (CONFIDENTIALITY) OR INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 6, NEITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL EXCEED THE TOTAL FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
7.2 Consequential Damages Waiver. IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION.

ARTICLE 8: NON-COMPETITION AND NON-SOLICITATION
8.1 Non-Solicitation. During the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party involved in the performance of Services.
8.2 Non-Competition. Vendor agrees not to provide directly competing software development services to Client's three primary named competitors for a period of six (6) months following the termination of any active SOW.

ARTICLE 9: TERM AND TERMINATION
9.1 Term. This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a period of two (2) years unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Section.
9.2 Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
9.3 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate immediately if the other party breaches any material term and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of written notice.

ARTICLE 10: GENERAL PROVISIONS
10.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflict of laws principles.
10.2 Dispute Resolution. Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved through binding arbitration administered by JAMS in San Francisco, California.
